open_points: index.html already has apple-touch-icon pointing to unicircle-logo.png (line 11); replace it with the icons/icon-192.png one or keep it.
assetlinks.json holds the placeholder REPLACE_WITH_SHA256_FROM_PLAY_CONSOLE; human fills it after the Bubblewrap/Play signing step.
Messages shortcut points to /#feed as instructed (no separate messages route yet).

sw.js precache list mirrors current index.html assets; update it and bump VERSION when index.html adds or removes files. Cache-busting ?v= query strings are ignored on lookup (ignoreSearch), so a changed ?v= alone will serve the stale copy until revalidated in the background.
Must be served from the site root over HTTPS; .well-known/ and sw.js must be deployed on KAS (live site), and /.well-known/assetlinks.json must not redirect.
manifest.webmanifest should be served as application/manifest+json (or at least a JSON type); check KAS .htaccess if Lighthouse complains.
